# Conduct and Confidentiality
Staff represent the Company whenever they are on site. These policies apply at all times, on and off shift.
## Professional Conduct - Staff must wear their issued uniform on duty and keep it clean. - Staff must be courteous to colleagues, colonists and visitors. - Alcohol and recreational drugs are not permitted on duty. - Disputes between staff are to be taken to the Liaison.
## Confidentiality - Company information may not be disclosed to anyone outside the Company. This includes colonists, officials, friends and family. - Documents and data may not be removed from the office. - Information overheard by accident is still confidential. - Questions from colonists, officials or the press must be referred to the Liaison. Staff are to say they can't comment.
Breaching confidentiality is grounds for dismissal.
## Agreements - Only the Liaison or a more senior employee may make agreements or promises on the Company's behalf. - Staff may not sign anything for the Company.
## Gifts and Favours - Staff may not accept gifts, payment or favours from anyone they deal with at work. - Any offer must be declined and reported to the Liaison.
## Weapons - Office staff may not carry weapons on duty. - Staff may defend themselves if attacked. Everything else is left to Corporate Security.
## Raising Concerns - Concerns are to be raised with the Liaison. - Concerns about the Liaison are to be raised with Company counsel, or with the senior employee on site.
